3 رادّهُ , (L and TA in art. رود,) inf. n. مُرَادَدَةٌ, (TA in that art.,) or مُرَادَّةٌ, (TK in the present art.,) He endeavoured to turn him [from, or to, a thing]; syn. رَاجَعَهُ and رَاوَدَهُ. (L in art. رود.) ―
-b2- رادّهُ الشَّىْءَ: see 1, in the former half of the paragraph. [Hence,] رادّهُ القَوْلَ [and رادّهُ فِى القَوْلِ (occurring in the TA in art. عت)] He disputed with him, rebutting, or rejecting, or repudiating, in reply to him, what he said; he bandied words with him; syn. رَاجَعَهُ. (A.) And رادّهُ البَيْعَ He dissolved, or annulled, with him the sale; syn. قَايَلَهُ. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
